turns.user: List 3DCP mortars from the literature whose static yield stress after 60 minutes of rest exceeds 10 kPa.
turns.text:
I’ll check the literature records for measured 60-minute static yield stress and keep the reported values separate from estimates.
The direct measurements include qualifying mixes from two papers. I’m checking the time-series records as well, since some studies report the 60-minute value only in a curve.
I found **20 qualifying 60-minute records from seven 3DCP mortar papers**: seven values reported directly in text or a table, and 13 measured points read from figures. All values below exceed 10 kPa. Figure-read values are approximate; the calculated curves in the same figures are excluded.

| Paper | Mortar | Static yield stress at 60 min |
|---|---|---:|
| [Waste-glass geopolymers](https://doi.org/10.1080/21650373.2025.2529994), §4.3.2 | 50S/50F; 50S/35F/15G; 50S/20F/30G; 50S/0F/50G | 40; 34; 21; 15 kPa |
| [Fine-aggregate matric suction](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2022.127618), Table 2 | 30%; 20%; 10% silica-sand replacement | 19.86; 18.91; 13.04 kPa |
| [Geopolymer mortar](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2021.104060), Fig. 14 | M5 | ≈47.3 kPa |
| [Heavyweight mortar](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.matdes.2023.112246), Fig. 14 | M100; M0 | ≈55.2; ≈40.9 kPa |
| [Underwater and air printing](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2023.134403), Fig. 6 | G1_0.40WC_0.04HEC (air); G1_0.40WC_0.06HEC (air, underwater); G1_0.40WC_0.08HEC (underwater); G2_0.40WC_0.02WLG, 0.04WLG, 0.06WLG (air) | ≈10.7; ≈17.8, ≈14.5; ≈16.7; ≈10.7, ≈17.9, ≈20.2 kPa |
| [Rice-husk bio-aggregate](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jobe.2024.111740), Fig. 7b | RH20; RH25 | ≈11.6; ≈14.0 kPa |
| [Printed-concrete bond strength](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.autcon.2020.103394), Fig. 16 | Printed concrete mixture | ≈16.0 kPa |

The Fig. 6 readings come from a dense, overlapping chart and have **low extraction confidence**, especially the values close to 10 kPa. Test methods also differ across papers, so these values should not be treated as directly interchangeable.

The database query exports are [directly reported values](<C:\Users\User\3D Printing Concrete Prediction\artifacts\reports\agent\20261016-172047-071f\sql_1792138891.csv>) and [figure candidates with extraction notes](<C:\Users\User\3D Printing Concrete Prediction\artifacts\reports\agent\20261016-172047-071f\sql_1792138945.csv>).

input.sql: SELECT p.doi,x.name_in_paper,c.x_quantity,c.y_unit,cp.y_value,c.source_locator,c.extraction_confidence FROM curves c JOIN curve_points cp ON cp.curve_uid=c.curve_uid JOIN mixes x ON x.mix_uid=c.mix_uid JOIN papers p ON p.paper_uid=c.paper_uid WHERE p.is_3dcp_study='1' AND x.system_type='mortar' AND c.y_quantity='static_yield_stress' AND c.x_quantity IN ('rest_time','resting_time','time') AND ((c.x_unit='min' AND CAST(NULLIF(cp.x_value,'') AS REAL)=60) OR (c.x_unit='s' AND CAST(NULLIF(cp.x_value,'') AS REAL)=3600)) AND ((c.y_unit='Pa' AND CAST(NULLIF(cp.y_value,'') AS REAL)>10000) OR (c.y_unit IN ('kPa','kN/m2') AND CAST(NULLIF(cp.y_value,'') AS REAL)>10)) ORDER BY p.doi,x.name_in_paper,c.curve_uid LIMIT 15 OFFSET 0
